page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Printed page number and running head at the top, above the text. Below the last line, a stray "/" mark, not a catchword or signature.

main_text.p: les, bellicas esse dicimus. hoc, cum nauis partes enumeramus: carinam, proram, puppim, gubernaculum, malū, velum, transtra & remos. At verò si quis locum aliquem, & ut vulgò loquimur, materiam Juris civilis, veluti tutelarum, actionum, obligationum, tractare instituat, tum illarum rationum alterutra uti debebit. Sed tempus est, nostræ huius, quam solam retinemus, analyticæ tractationis exemplum proponere. Nos autem neque obscurū, neq;, ut speramus, infructuosum hoc initiò exponemus. Justinianus libro Institutio-num

page.notes: The running head is ornamental black-letter type and could not be read. The stray "/" below the text is probably a printer's or scan mark, not a catchword or signature. Spelling changed per the u/v and i/j rule: "uero", "uelum", "uulgò" and "ciuilis" are written with v; "Iuris" and "Iustinianus" with J. The ligature "ct" in "tractare", "actionum" and "instituat" is rendered as printed. The word "tractationis" is written whole because no hyphen is printed at the line end.
